# Cheapest-LLM Router (CLR)

> Route any prompt to the cheapest reachable LLM — free tiers first, cheapest paid fallback second.

MCP server that routes any prompt to the cheapest reachable LLM (free tiers first, cheapest paid fallback second). Reuses the free/cheap model channels of Free & Cheap Tokens (FACT). Four tools: route · cost_compare · list_models · cache_route. Zero-dependency, runs over stdio.

## Endpoint (hosted, Apify Pay-Per-Event)
https://neeenja--cheapest-llm-router.apify.actor/mcp

## Source
https://github.com/PanStories/cheapest-llm-router

## Tools
- route — prompt → cheapest reachable model + USD/CNY cost + fallback chain + reasoning
- cost_compare — rank every reachable model by cost, report max savings
- list_models — filtered registry listing (capability / region / free-only)
- cache_route — same as route, demonstrates the in-process cache

## Pricing (Pay-Per-Event)
- route / list_models / cache_route: $0.0005 per call
- cost_compare: $0.001 per call
- initialize / tools/list / report-issue: free
